author: Codex documentation author; corrections by DOC-029 source-review author agent (admin-config)

prerequisites: Seeded fictional Administrator signed in on the admin documentation lab.
Reviewer-created Matter type with an optional Text Field, a required Text Field and a Global Entity Field; a No-target Matter request form submitted by the seeded Business User.
scenarios.expected: The template saves Priority, Risk, Title prefix, Field defaults, ordered Tasks and Key dates. Direct creation and Request conversion create Tasks and Key dates from the Matter's UTC creation date. Direct creation uses the template defaults; conversion keeps the Request's Urgency and title, leaves Risk unset and makes the converting person Matter Manager. A Matter Manager Task stays unassigned without a manager. Editing the template does not change earlier Matters. An archived template is not offered and is refused.
scenarios.actual: 8 recorded steps passed on 3fa407e3. Add template, Edit, Matter defaults (Low, Medium, "Supplier -"), Custom field defaults, three Tasks with offsets 2, blank and 5 (the third moved up with ArrowUp) and Key dates at 10 and 0 saved and read back after reload. 3651 and a blank Key date offset were refused with "Give every row a name and use whole-number offsets from 0 to 3650 days." and nothing saved. Create matter with the template suggested "Supplier -", Low, Medium, the Field defaults and Daniel Okafor as Matter Manager; with the optional Field cleared, M-45 kept it empty, got Tasks due 2026-09-18 and 2026-09-21 assigned to Daniel Okafor plus one undated unassigned Task, and Key dates 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-26 from the 2026-09-16 UTC creation date. With Matter Manager Unassigned every Task stayed unassigned. Converting R-50 with the template created M-47 with the Request title, Priority high (template Low), Risk unset (template Medium), Daniel Okafor as Matter Manager with the Manager Tasks, the carried Entity answer, the template Field defaults and the same relative dates. After the template Task was edited, M-45 kept its Tasks and a new Matter used the edit. Archive template removed it from Create matter, POST /api/v1/matters with it answered 400 "The template must be live and belong to the selected matter type.", and Show archived > Restore brought it back. A detached Field's default was named as retained and returned after reattach.

prerequisites: Seeded fictional Legal Team Member signed in on the admin documentation lab in a separate browser context.
scenarios.expected: Negative check: the Settings pages for this article do not open and the configuration API refuses the call.
scenarios.actual: Role confirmed as legal_team_member from /api/v1/me. /settings/matters/templates sent the browser to /settings/profile. GET /api/v1/matter-templates answered 403 ("You do not have permission to perform this action.").

prerequisites: Seeded fictional Business User signed in to the Portal with a fresh emailed sign-in link in a separate browser context.
scenarios.expected: Negative check: the Settings pages for this article do not open and the configuration API refuses the call.
scenarios.actual: Role confirmed as business_user from /api/v1/me. /settings/matters/templates sent the browser to /portal. GET /api/v1/matter-templates answered 403 ("You do not have permission to perform this action.").

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and technical reviewer; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

The admin lab is shared with other DOC-029 agents. Records were named DOC-029 admin-config. Organisation reminder lead times were changed during the run and restored to 30, 14, 7, 1, and On the day; this was confirmed after reload.

Earlier development runs of the same script (logs not kept) failed only on reviewer script errors and left extra DOC-029 admin-config records with other suffixes; walkthrough-r1.json reviewerNotes lists them.
Negative access checks used the seeded Legal Team Member (nadia.haddad) and Business User (jonas.weber), each in its own browser context; roles were confirmed from /api/v1/me.
AI preparation was off, so AI-proposed values in conversion were not observed.

A template section failing after an earlier section saved could not be produced from the browser: the editor refuses invalid rows before any section saves. The walkthrough confirmed that a refused save changed nothing.
Key date reorder and a template whose Matter type is archived were not checked in the browser; the archived-template refusal was checked with POST /api/v1/matters using the body the dialog had sent.

compatibilityReview.summary: From 3fa407e3 to 57e77e38, round 2 (DOC-029r2 compatibility reviewer (admin-config)) found the article compatible: I inspected the 3fa407e3..57e77e38 app diff and found no change to the Matter template settings, the template editor, the Create matter and Convert dialogs, or the matter-templates, matters, requests and fields API modules; the shared list-editor and Settings changes do not alter any step in the article. I replayed the round 1 V-C39 walkthrough on the admin2 lab built from 57e77e38, and all eight Administrator steps and both negative role checks passed with the same outcomes. From 57e77e38 to 432dba3a, round 3 found only apps/web/src/routes/welcome.tsx and its test changed. The wizard now goes to /auth/two-factor/enroll after it saves a policy that requires two-factor authentication. The article makes no statement about the setup wizard Authentication step or two-factor enrollment. The change touches only apps/web/src/routes/welcome.tsx and its test, so no statement in the article can become wrong.
